request.text: One car-to-car side collision. Sharp steel contact, short buckling grind, debris settling. No engine bed or tyre squeal. Timbre: a deep restrained chassis groan with one sharp panel crease. Intimate damped metal, low gritty resonance, restrained high end, tiny dry reflection. 1.5 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.
